name: Also Capital
identity_check: Confirmed as Also Capital (alsocapital.com; site operated by Also Capital Management LLC per its terms), the hard-tech early-stage firm founded by Managing Partner Mike Annunziata (ex-Farther Farms co-founder, Varda Space board member), with Varda CEO Will Bruey named as a co-founder. Its blog Also Blog Posts (alsoblogposts.com) announces the $21M first fund (2024-10-17) and $50M second fund (2026-02-24). The homepage lists Tandem (Seed) as a portfolio company with the description 'Neutral context layer capturing intent from hardware design decisions', matching our competitor Tandem (tandem.inc). Not ALSO Holding (Swiss IT distributor), not 'Also' the Rivian e-bike spin-off, and not Allos or Aleph-style similarly named funds.
